title: Outbox event (Kafka topics nova.outbox.<aggregate>, key aggregate_id)
description: Debezium's outbox EventRouter publishes outbox.payload as the record value, with id, tenant_id and type as headers. Every side-effect notification is one of these (CLAUDE.md rule 8: written by an idempotent action in the same transaction). Consumer: the ingest notifier (mock sink).

refs.description: Ids the message is about, e.g. {exception_id, shipment_id} or {invoice_no}.
